entry.title: General Comment No. 8 (2022) on the right of persons with disabilities to work and employment
entry.summary: General Comment / Recommendation · CRPD/C/GC/8 · Committee on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities · 2022 — The Committee clarifies the obligations of States parties regarding the right to work and employment of persons with disabilities under article 27 of the Convention, and considers that meaningful realization of this right requires the elimination of disability-based discrimination in employment, equal access to the open labour market, reasonable accommodation and inclusive support measures.

entry.title: General Comment No. 7 (2018) on the participation of persons with disabilities, including children with disabilities, through their representative organizations, in the implementation and monitoring of the Convention
entry.summary: General Comment / Recommendation · CRPD/C/GC/7 · Committee on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities · 2018 — The Committee considers that meaningful participation of persons with disabilities through their representative organizations is a Convention principle and a tool for empowerment, and clarifies States parties' obligations under articles 4 (3) and 33 (3) to consult closely and actively involve persons with disabilities in the development of laws, policies and decisions concerning them.

entry.title: General Comment No. 6 (2018) on equality and non-discrimination
entry.summary: General Comment / Recommendation · CRPD/C/GC/6 · Committee on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities · 2018 — The Committee considers that article 5 prohibits all forms of disability-based discrimination — direct, indirect, by association, denial of reasonable accommodation and harassment — and clarifies States parties' obligations to recognize disability-based discrimination as a violation of human rights and to ensure equality through positive measures.

entry.title: General Comment No. 5 (2017) on living independently and being included in the community
entry.summary: General Comment / Recommendation · CRPD/C/GC/5 · Committee on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities · 2017 — The Committee considers that article 19 — the right to live independently and be included in the community — entails a fundamental shift away from institutionalization and segregation towards community-based living arrangements, and clarifies States parties' obligations to provide individualized support, accessible services and choice over living arrangements.

entry.title: General Comment No. 4 (2016) on the right to inclusive education
entry.summary: General Comment / Recommendation · CRPD/C/GC/4 · Committee on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities · 2016 — The Committee considers that the right to inclusive education under article 24 is a fundamental human right and the only means to achieve quality education for all, and clarifies States parties' obligations to develop inclusive education systems that combat discrimination, respect diversity and accommodate every learner.
